Findings.Question: Q05
Findings.Defect: parse_constant rejects literal NaN/Infinity but not exponent overflow. JSON tokens 1e999 and 2e999 both become floating-point Infinity and survive load_handoff, schema_problems and same(). A synthetic pair containing those Attempt values and the authorized WorkCompleted append returned PASS/0 with no reasons. Non-finite, ambiguous numeric evidence is therefore accepted.
Findings.Authority: owner-decision-a5-freetext.md:47 requires malformed, ambiguous or incomplete evidence to fail closed; coordinator-order-a5-freetext.md:109 requires Infinity rejection; I-64-A-5.md:103 freezes rejection of parse/evidence/identity ambiguity. LIFECYCLE Sec.5 makes an open failure path REQUIRED.
Findings.Correction: Reject non-finite numeric results at every nesting level, including exponent overflow, before comparison. Add positive and negative overflow regressions that require FAIL/nonzero. Publish corrected verifier identity and self-test evidence through the next append-only A-n for review.

Findings.Question: Q06
Findings.Defect: same() compares values only after lossy binary floating-point decoding. Distinct finite JSON numbers can become identical values and identical json.dumps output. With REAL Attempt=1.0 and MUTATED Attempt=1.00000000000000001, the exact verifier returned PASS/0, Identity.Attempt pass and ChangedFields=[WorkCompleted]. The additional difference was hidden. Underflow from 1e-999 to 0.0 creates the same defect.
Findings.Authority: owner-decision-a5-freetext.md:46 requires identity and non-FreeText fields unchanged; coordinator-order-a5-freetext.md:115 and :122-131 require identical Attempt, structural equivalence and no additional mutation. A-5 Sec.2 promises strict value/type equality and only WorkCompleted changed. LIFECYCLE Sec.5 requires a verifiable invariant.
Findings.Correction: Preserve numeric values losslessly before comparison, or fail closed on unsupported numeric encodings. Compare exact values and types recursively without floating-point rounding or underflow masking differences. Add precision-loss and underflow regressions requiring FAIL/nonzero, and freeze the correction and new blob in the next A-n.
